title: One Stroke Dots
description: Trace a single unbroken glowing line across every tile on the board without lifting your finger or retracing your path across hundreds of clever brain-teasers.
controls: Drag smoothly from the starting tile across adjacent squares to fill the entire grid in one continuous stroke.

zh-CN.title: 一笔画连点成线
zh-CN.description: 抖音超火烧脑一笔画完：从起点出发不回头不重复，一笔串联点亮全场所有格子，看似简单却专治各种不服！
zh-CN.controls: 从起点方块按住滑动，连续不间断经过并填满地图上的每一个格子即可过关。
